**Install:** download `Rozan-…-arm64.dmg`, open it, drag **Rozan** to **Applications**, then open it.
The first launch shows **Rozan Setup**, which checks Ollama, Python 3.11+, Rozan's packages, the AI model
and the Chrome connection, each with an Install button.

The app is not notarized by Apple yet. The first time, macOS may say it can't verify the developer:
open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway** next to Rozan (or run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Rozan.app`).

Apple silicon Macs, macOS 14 or later.
